**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than today’s richest 1%. We believe this is the future within reach—and we’re working to make sure its benefits belong to everyone.

3. Superintelligent AI within 20 years will make every person on Earth wealthier than today’s richest 1%. We believe it—and we’re focused on ensuring this extraordinary abundance reaches everyone.

**(b) Newsletter opening**

We believe the next 20 years can bring a transformation unlike anything in human history. If superintelligent AI is built within that time, every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are today. That is the future we are working toward: one where extraordinary abundance is not confined to a handful of people, but improves life for everyone. This conviction shapes how we think about the choices ahead. The systems we build, the policies we pursue, and the way we share the gains will determine whether AI’s promise reaches all of us. We are here to make that promise real—and to build a world where everyone can thrive.
